en.label: [section] Aim of the course and learning outcomes:
en.content: Aim of study is to obtain knowledge about general chemistry and cemistry of inorganic, organic, natural and macromolecular compounds, their structures, charakters and their role in nature. Students should be able to understand the relationship between structure of compounds and their physico-chemical properties.
